## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 24 ago 2026 - 26 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _y. Reddy_, 26 ago 2026, 1/5: "Editing to respond to the developer: When the 'free' experience is frustrating and ineffective, yes you should be sorry. This app is like using a calculator that makes you pay for the total after you hit 'enter'. You decided to put basic nutritional information behind a paywall because of greed and nothing else. Your free features are useless I forgot why I deleted this app years ago. Putting everything from protein onwards behind a paywall is a gross cash grab and you should be ashamed."
            2. _RJ_, 26 ago 2026, 1/5: "too many notifications about upgrading from a paid premium account to an even more expensive premium plus account. I can't disable those notifications that come up every other day. you guys are already collecting money from me, but you want more for an upgraded experience? I'll be requesting a refund and finding another app."
            3. _Richard Mead_, 25 ago 2026, 1/5: "So much is behind a subscription based paywall that using the app for more than basic tracking is useless. Use a less restricted app instead of mfp"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Presión publicitaria** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Presión publicitaria.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona presión publicitaria.
      Ventana de reseñas: 24 ago 2026 - 24 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios notan presión publicitaria. Señala fricción de monetización y una apertura para un competidor más limpio.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Robyn Scott_, 24 ago 2026, 3/5: "Ads are slow to load and cause the page to shift just as you're about to touch your screen. Audio in ads is annoying and takes over other audio. Otherwise, this is the best tracking app I've ran across, but I won't recommend it until the ad issued are gone."
<!--/ir-theme-->

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
